item.title: At least 13 Niger soldiers killed in Sanam armed attack
item.description: It remains unclear who carried out the attack on Niger's National Guard in Tillaberi, near the Mali border.

item.title: Trump downplays Russia, China support for Iran during talks with US troops
item.description: Trump praises US troops for their role in the war on Iran and says he has spoken to Netanyahu in recent days.

item.title: Asian stock markets rise after earlier tech rout
item.description: Indices in Japan, South Korea, Australia and Hong Kong rise as New Zealand stocks dip on election uncertainty.

item.title: Spain and Morocco under-17 stars target World Cup 2030
item.description: Spain and Morocco are two of the co-hosts of the next 2030 World Cup, and they faced off at the under-17 World Cup.

item.title: Zelenskyy warns of major Russian attack as Trump urges Putin to ‘pull back’
item.description: Trump says he urged Putin to 'pull back' military aggression in Europe amid escalating Russian and Ukrainian attacks.

item.title: Trump says the US has ‘close to 50%’ of world’s oil
item.description: On a call to soldiers deployed to the Gulf, Donald Trump claimed that the US does not ‘need Middle East oil'.

item.title: Clashes halt match as Turkiye football fans raise Palestinian flags
item.description: Clashes broke out between Georgian police and Turkish club Besiktas supporters during a UEFA match.

item.title: Global news agency AFP reports cyberattack, shuts down content platform
item.description: France's cybersecurity chief urges collective action to combat unprecedented threat levels in the nation.

item.title: Inside Ukraine’s power crisis amid its war with Russia
item.description: Electricity and water shortages have become part of daily life in Ukraine’s capital.

item.title: America’s Thanksgiving holiday seen through different eyes
item.description: As millions of Americans celebrate Thanksgiving, Indigenous people gather in Plymouth for the National Day of Mourning.

item.title: Argentina bars Central Bank from printing money to fund government spending
item.description: The South American country's Senate also advances proposal to suspend primary elections ahead of 2027 presidential race.

item.title: Iran war live: Iran’s Araghchi calls deadly Kuwait attack ‘suspicious’
item.description: Iran's FM Abbas Araghchi says the deadly Kuwait incident is "suspicious" and looks like a "pre-cooked recipe" for war.

item.title: Georgian police clash with Turkiye’s Besiktas fans over Palestinian flag
item.description: Match between Besiktas and Hapoel Beer-Sheva suspended for 30 minutes after confrontation between fans and police.

item.title: Israeli settlers damage Palestinian family’s homes in West Bank attack
item.description: The Tubasi family was forced out months ago and has been denied a return by settlers despite an Israeli court order.

item.title: In Canada, Quebec’s religious symbols ban faces a Supreme Court test
item.description: Canada’s top court weighs Bill 21, the Quebec law that shapes where Muslim women can work and where they feel welcome.

item.title: Report: CIA tortured more people with waterboarding than US agency admitted
item.description: A New York Times report lends credence to long-held belief that torture method was more widely used than acknowledged.

item.title: Egypt detains driver over Cairo fuel tanker fire that killed 31
item.description: Prosecutors order drug tests for the 21-year-old suspect, who says he was overtaking when the crash happened.

item.title: Bangladesh garment workers clash with police over low wages
item.description: Bangladeshi garment workers clashed with police after a 36% minimum wage increase fell short of their demands.

item.title: Attack on Saudi’s Jazan refinery kills one person, disrupts operations
item.description: The attack killed a Nepali national, injured several people and sparked a fire, Saudi Energy Ministry says.

item.title: Indian politician facing murder charges hosts 400,000-guest wedding
item.description: An estimated 400,000 people attended politician Anant Singh’s daughter’s lavish wedding in Bihar, India’s poorest state.

item.title: Mexico seeks US talks about suspected SpaceX debris
item.description: Mexico concerned as SpaceX ramps up rocket launches from Starbase near border in Texas.

item.title: Musk pledges two SpaceX shares for every US child
item.description: US children would receive one share from SpaceX and one from him personally, Musk said.

item.title: Peru burns more than 10 tonnes of seized drugs
item.description: Peru began burning 10.7 tonnes of seized narcotics in its seventh and final drug disposal operation of 2026

item.title: Why are winter rains forcing Palestinians in Gaza to flee again?
item.description: Israeli restrictions on humanitarian aid, damaged buildings and flooded tents leave displaced Palestinians vulnerable.

item.title: Judge strikes down Trump’s latest restrictions on US birthright citizenship
item.description: After a Supreme Court ruling against it, the Trump administration had tried a narrower set of restrictions.
